judge.rationale: The candidate only generated a definition of done (`.lore/dod.md`), a brief addition to the spec files, and an acceptance test file (`src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`), without modifying a single line of production code. None of the required changes to `src/types/messages.ts`, `src/types/session.ts`, `src/transport/ws/validation.ts`, `src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts`, `src/transport/createServer.ts`, or `src/config.ts` were implemented. Because `HalEngineConfig.transport.history` and the new message types do not exist in the codebase, the candidate's own test file will fail to compile and fail all tests. Documentation (`docs/getting-started.md`, `example/full-config.ts`) and `CHANGELOG.md` updates were also completely omitted.
